stations.title: 01 COMPARISON BAY
stations.instructions: OLD/NEW exterior cases share the coordinator's functional scripts and approved optic. Read each numbered pad identity. Park engines off between listening tests. Never fire here. Reset only empty vehicles parked at their own pads. Full released-code comparisons require a separate run.

stations.title: 02 DRIVE LOOP
stations.instructions: Start EAST at G01. The straight is80m: reverse between START and the50m marker; brake at60m and stop before80m. Follow the numbered80x25m rectangle and service connector at low speed. Check ground contact and clearance as you go. Use identical load and assistance.

stations.title: 03 FUEL / REARM / REPAIR
stations.instructions: Park inside the three stock trucks. Left/right rear fuel-cap action beside tanker; rear engine-deck repair actions with wrench held. Rearm both 35 mm feeds beside ammo truck. Supplies are finite: 1000 per ammo/repair source at setup. Reset sources here explicitly when empty. No automatic vehicle healing or refilling. WCS smoke supply is excluded.

stations.title: 04 TARGET LANE /100m AND300m
stations.instructions: Fire EAST from the paired cones only. T100 is100m and T300 is300m horizontal. Only these two targets are open. Keep downrange empty and check the sight picture before firing. Do not use this station during damage tests.

stations.title: 05 DAMAGE FORK /EAST AND NORTH
stations.instructions: EXPENDABLE subjects only: D1 EAST100m at1000/2780; D2 NORTH40m at900/2820. Fire only EAST to D1 or NORTH to D2. Never SOUTH or WEST. Pause all other stations during damage; clear every subject and downrange area. M2 starts aimed EAST; use hand weapons for the NORTH lane. Subjects never autoheal. Wait for fire/secondary explosions, exit seats and clear pads before reset. Shots are not physically confined; keep to the marked directions.

stations.title: 06 OPTIONAL HOSTILE CELL
stations.instructions: OFF by default. Coordinator must first qualify terrain backstop, enclosure, native AI and projectile containment; profile GPG-hostiles-qualified.flag then permits local arm action. Enter only deliberately. Two stock USSR sentries use a small defend waypoint, 35 m boundary and 180 s expiry. Leaving the cell ends the encounter. Boundary/timeout clears owned agents; never assume it catches bullets already fired. Stop action remains available.
